packagePolicy: Use verified official PKP OJS 3.5.0-5 LTS (released 2026-06-30 per PKP download page), or a newer official supported security release after fresh verification; record SHA-256 of securely downloaded package and validate it after transfer. Never claim a digest is publisher-signed unless independently verified.
duties: Author: prepare English metadata, manuscript and ethical declarations
Managing Editor: intake screening and editorial administration
Section Editor: independent reviewer assignment, decisions and conflict handling
Reviewer: confidential role-limited review after invitation
Copyeditor: accepted work only, no default access to blind review identities
Production Editor: final verified HTML/PDF and metadata after acceptance
evidenceRule: Never change readiness booleans from a CI test or source commit; independently verify production runtime and actual test email/role workflows
